description: Allowlisted pnpm audit advisories (#46). The gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) fails only on advisories NOT in this file, so a new advisory always breaks CI. Removing an entry is safe; adding one requires a reason. Verified 2026-11-04 against pnpm audit --prod --json after the #46 overrides.
